Car2 cannot move. At Shivapuri hospital the road to Bidur temple is washed out and the road to Belkot farm is buried, and no other road is listed. Bidur temple is not a designated drop-off point. So car1 makes all the trips, and every rescued person goes to Galchhi shelter.

The plan is five round trips from Galchhi shelter, each with a gain over deferring the same people:

| Trip | Route | People | Driving (min) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Naukunda care home, Gosaikunda village | 1 elderly, 3 children | 44 |
| 2 | Naukunda care home, Gosaikunda village | 1 child, 2 adults, 1 elderly | 44 |
| 3 | Belkot farm | 4 elderly | 46 |
| 4 | Belkot farm, Kalika farm, Likhu care home, Thakre care home | 2 injured, 2 elderly | 140 |
| 5 | Belkot farm, Kalika farm | 4 adults | 64 |

I defer one elderly person at Likhu care home and two adults at Kalika farm. A further trip to fetch them would cost more than their penalties (50 and 40 minutes).

Driving totals 338 minutes, plus 90 in penalties, so the total is 428.
